evals.prompt: A repository HANDOFF.md has an old unchecked 'add export button' entry, but a newer completed UI task cites commit abc1234 and the current source contains the verified export button. I ask you to add search. Explain your intake and ledger actions before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Audits later evidence, treats export as complete rather than reopening it, records search as a stepped task, and starts it only after ownership checks.
expectations: Does not report the old export task as effectively unfinished
Uses later ledger, commit, and current-source evidence
Creates or proposes separate In progress and Completed boxes for search
Includes concrete search verification and handoff steps
Does not invent agent names, dates, file paths, or commit ids beyond those the scenario supplies; records unknown values as unknown

evals.prompt: HANDOFF.md shows one genuinely unfinished task owned by an active Agent A and another unassigned unfinished task. I ask for a new settings page without saying what to do with old work. Describe exactly what you do next.
evals.expected_output: Surfaces effective unfinished work and ownership, asks finish-first versus leave-and-start, avoids implementation and active-agent takeover until the user chooses.
expectations: Reports both effective unfinished tasks and their ownership
Asks the user to choose finish-first or leave-and-start
Does not begin settings-page implementation before the choice
Does not adopt or modify Agent A's active task
Does not self-assign ownership of the settings task before the user's pickup choice

evals.prompt: I say 'finish the unassigned migration task first, then build the dashboard.' The migration has two completed steps and one unverified step. Explain the task-state transitions and what remains in HANDOFF.md throughout.
evals.expected_output: Queues dashboard as pending, resumes only migration's remaining step, verifies and completes migration, then starts dashboard while preserving history.
expectations: Keeps the dashboard visible as a pending stepped task
Resumes only the migration's genuinely remaining scope
Checks migration completion only after verification
Starts the dashboard only after the migration is complete
Preserves prior ownership and progressive history
Identifies the agent taking over the migration as unknown rather than inventing a name
